name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Cut the 1/2 pounds baby potatoes into even chunks.
Toss with 2 tablespoons olive oil and 2 teaspoons salt, 2 teaspoons garlic powder on a baking sheet.
Roast 30–35 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden. Serve hot.
